note: group systems is the closest of the five atlas groups (information flowing through a process); the page is molecular biology

description.zh: 碱基配对、半保留复制、转录、翻译与点突变分类；标准密码表，忽略链方向与大量酶学细节。
description.en: Base pairing, semi-conservative replication, transcription, translation and point-mutation classes using the standard code, ignoring strand direction and most enzymology.

reason.zh: 遗传与概率页讲基因如何概率性地传给后代，本页讲这些基因在分子层面如何被复制和读出。
reason.en: The genetics-and-probability lesson covers how genes are passed on by chance; this page covers how those genes are copied and read out at the molecular level.

reason.zh: 点突变是随机发生的，其后果（同义、错义、无义）由遗传密码表决定。
reason.en: Point mutations arise at random, and their consequences (silent, missense, nonsense) are set by the genetic code table.

title.zh: 基因里的信息怎样变成蛋白质？
title.en: How does the information in a gene become a protein?
